units.title: SG-1.2.1 · Add the zustand dependency to the frontend package.json and lockfile
Act: Add zustand to game/frontend package.json and package-lock.json
Verify: zustand dependency declaration and resolution unit tests

tests.name: declares a semver-pinned zustand version in package.json
tests.title: declares a semver-pinned zustand version in package.json
tests.scenario: Given the frontend package.json on disk, when the zustand dependency is read, then it is declared with a major.minor.patch range (optionally ^ or ~).
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/zustandDependency.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: records the same zustand range in package-lock.json root entry
tests.title: records the same zustand range in package-lock.json root entry
tests.scenario: Given the package-lock.json root package entry, when its zustand dependency is read, then it equals the range declared in package.json.
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/zustandDependency.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: resolves zustand to a concrete version in package-lock.json
tests.title: resolves zustand to a concrete version in package-lock.json
tests.scenario: Given the package-lock.json node_modules/zustand entry, when its version is read, then it is a non-empty string.
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/zustandDependency.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: resolves the zustand import
tests.title: resolves the zustand import
tests.scenario: Given the zustand package installed in node_modules, when the module is dynamically imported, then its create export is a function.
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/zustandDependency.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

units.title: REQ · zustand is declared in package.json and locked in package-lock.json
